The files give the SAMPL9 WP6 host (a carboxylated pillar[6]arene; host file shown with 12 carboxylates) and four candidate guests as 3D structures (XYZ, angstrom). Binding to WP6 was measured by isothermal titration calorimetry in 1× PBS at pH 7.40 and 298.15 K; all complexes are 1:1. Which guest binds WP6 most strongly, i.e. has the most negative measured binding free energy?

选项：
A. G7: cyclohexylammonium (WP6-G7.xyz)
B. G1: cyclododecylammonium (WP6-G1.xyz)
C. G12: trimethyl-[6-(trimethylammonio)-2-adamantyl]ammonium (WP6-G12.xyz)
D. G6: cyclooctylammonium (WP6-G6.xyz)

附件：WP6.xyz、WP6-G12.xyz、WP6-G6.xyz、WP6-G7.xyz、WP6-G1.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：主体与客体为 SAMPL9 提供的 3D 结构；答案依据实测 ITC 结合自由能（1× PBS，pH 7.40，298.15 K，1:1），证据只在审核侧。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
